result.topic_en: This spread finishes the example N = 223, showing that 2^37 − 1 is divisible by 223 and that the residue computation can be shortened. It then applies Euler's residue algorithm to N = 641, showing 641 divides 2^32 + 1 with a shortcut via fourth powers, and starts the example N = 385 = 5·7·11.
result.transcription:

ergo $x = 37$, et formula $2^{x} - 1$ diuisibilis per 223. Hinc quia 37 [?] est numerus impar, certum est, nullam dari formulam $2^{x} + 1$ per 223 diuisibilem.

§. 17. Quo nunc pateat, quomodo has operationes possint subleuari, subsistamus iam in quinta, vbi residuum prodiit 15, et summa exponentium $= 18$; vnde haec potestas $2^{x-18}$ residuum dat 15. Sumantur quadrata, et potestas $2^{2x-36}$ residuum dat 225 siue 2; haec iam per primam diuisa praebet pro potestate $2^{x-36}$ residuum $2 = 2^{1}\cdot 1$, ergo potestas $2^{x-37}$ praebet residuum 1, vnde iam liquet esse $x = 37$.

Exemplum 8.
§. 18. Sit $N = 641$, et primum residuum $= 1$, fiet:
$1 - 641 = -640 = -2^{7}\cdot 5$ . . . 7
$-5 + 641 = +636 = 2^{2}\cdot 159$ . . . 9
$+159 + 641 = +800 = 2^{5}\cdot 25$ . . . 14
$+25 - 641 = -616 = -2^{3}\cdot 77$ . . . 17
$-77 + 641 = 564 = 2^{2}\cdot 141$ . . . 19
$+141 - 641 = -500 = -2^{2}\cdot 125$ . . . 21
$-125 + 641 = 516 = 2^{2}\cdot 129$ . . . 23
$+129 - 641 = -512 = -2^{9}\cdot 1$ . . . 32
vbi iam subsistere possumus. Quia enim residuum est $-1$, si pro primo residuo sumsissemus $-1$, vt formula quaereretur $2^{x} + 1$ per 641 diuisibilis, omnia sequentia residua signo contrario affecta prodiissent et vltimum fuisset $+1$; vnde rite concludimus esse $x = 32$; ita vt iam formula $2^{32} + 1$ sit diuisibilis per 641. Euidens autem est, pro minima formula huius formae $2^{x} - 1$ fore $x = 64$.
§. 19.

253
§. 19. Hunc autem laborem mirifice contrahere licet. Statim enim post primam operationem subsistere possemus, quae pro potestate $2^{x-7}$ praebet residuum 5. Sumamus statim potestatem quartam, et pro $2^{4x-28}$ habebimus residuum 625, siue $-16 = -2^{4}\cdot 1$, ita vt $2^{4x-32}$ conueniat residuum $-1$. Diuidendo igitur per cubum primae, seu $2^{3x}$, cuius residuum itidem est 1, etiam huius potestatis $2^{x-32}$ residuum erit $-1$, id quod ante per ambages eruimus.

Exemplum 9.
§. 20. Sit $N = 385 = 5\cdot 7\cdot 11$, et primum residuum $= 1$, erit:
$1 - 385 = -384 = -2^{7}\cdot 3$ . . . 7
$-3 - 385 = -388 = -2^{2}\cdot 97$ . . . 9
$-97 + 385 = 288 = +2^{5}\cdot 9$ . . . 14
$+9 - 385 = -376 = -2^{3}\cdot 47$ . . . 17
$-47 - 385 = -432 = -2^{4}\cdot 27$ . . . 21
$-27 - 385 = -412 = -2^{2}\cdot 103$ . . . 23
$-103 - 385 = -488 = -2^{3}\cdot 61$ . . . 26
$-61 + 385 = +324 = +2^{2}\cdot 81$ . . . 28
$+81 - 385 = -304 = -2^{4}\cdot 19$ . . . 32
$-19 - 385 = -404 = -2^{2}\cdot 101$ . . . 34
$-101 + 385 = +284 = +2^{2}\cdot 71$ . . . 36
$+71 + 385 = +456 = +2^{3}\cdot 57$ . . . 39
$+57 - 385 = -328 = -2^{3}\cdot 41$ . . . 42
$-41 + 385 = +344 = +2^{3}\cdot 43$ . . . 45
$+43 + 385 = +428 = +2^{2}\cdot 107$ . . . 47
$+107 + 385 = +492 = +2^{2}\cdot 123$ . . . 49
$+123 + 385 = +508 = +2^{2}\cdot 127$ . . . 51
$+127 + 385 = +512 = +2^{9}\cdot 1$ . . . 60

items.quote: Hinc quia 37 [?] est numerus impar, certum est, nullam dari formulam $2^{x} + 1$ per 223 diuisibilem.
items.english: Hence, since 37 is an odd number, it is certain that no formula 2^x + 1 divisible by 223 exists.

items.quote: Quo nunc pateat, quomodo has operationes possint subleuari, subsistamus iam in quinta
items.english: Now, to show how these operations can be lightened, let us stop already at the fifth step.

items.quote: ita vt iam formula $2^{32} + 1$ sit diuisibilis per 641.
items.english: So that the formula 2^32 + 1 is divisible by 641.

items.quote: Euidens autem est, pro minima formula huius formae $2^{x} - 1$ fore $x = 64$.
items.english: It is evident that for the smallest formula of the form 2^x − 1 [divisible by 641], x will be 64.

items.quote: Hunc autem laborem mirifice contrahere licet.
items.english: This labour, however, can be shortened remarkably.
